basics.name: Kiyoung Om
basics.label: Research Intern at NAVER LABS
basics.summary: Research intern at NAVER LABS and M.S. graduate from KAIST Graduate School of Data Science. My current research focuses on closed-loop covariate shift in traffic simulation for autonomous driving, with broader interests in generative models for optimization, control, and alignment.

work.summary: Research on closed-loop covariate shift in traffic simulation for autonomous driving.
highlights: Studying robust simulation and learning methods for autonomous vehicle policies interacting with dynamic traffic environments.
Focusing on distribution shift induced by closed-loop policy-environment interaction.
Developed subgradient lambda prediction methods for complex SCM optimization.
Improved optimization speed and efficiency through machine learning approaches.
